title: Precisely Done
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：precisely　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 precisely 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Precisely, in 1950 the driver measured the ticket at the platform, and everybody in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning: before the February rains the driver had ② precisely measured the ticket, and nobody had asked a single question. The driver had come to the station two days earlier, and spoke little of the station he had left behind him.

The timetable for February 1944 puts it plainer. The ticket was ③ precisely equal, and the passenger who kept it had ④ precisely booked it twice before the winter came; nothing in the station was ever done precisely in those days. The passenger wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every day thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else. He measured the ticket ⑤ precisely on the same day, and nobody in the station doubted it; of all who measured it that day, he measured it ⑥ precisely with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the station had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was that the ticket be booked ⑦ precisely every day, and that whoever did it be ⑧ precisely careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done precisely.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960 she measured the ticket ⑨ precisely with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Precisely, she said in 1962, that was the part the station never forgot; the timetable still speaks precisely of it. She kept the ticket in the same platform for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the station never forgot how precisely it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 精确地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had precisely measured …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 精确地（修饰形容词：precisely equal）
C. adv. 恰恰（评注性状语，置于句首：Precisely, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 恰恰（修饰过去分词：had precisely booked it）
E. adv. 精确地（句末状语：… precisely on the same day）
F. adv. 精确地（句末状语：… precisely with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 恰恰（被动结构中的中位状语：be booked precisely）
H. adv. 恰恰（修饰形容词：be precisely careful about the whole business）

items.q: precisely on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: precisely 意为“精确地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Precisely, in 1950 …。
precisely 意为“精确地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had precisely measured the ticket。
precisely 意为“精确地”，此处修饰形容词 equal（相等）：was precisely equal。
precisely 意为“恰恰”，此处修饰过去分词 booked：had precisely booked it twice。
precisely 意为“精确地”，此处置于句末修饰动词：measured the ticket precisely on the same day。
precisely 意为“精确地”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 日子, he did it precisely with great care。
precisely 意为“恰恰”，被动结构 be booked precisely 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
precisely 意为“恰恰”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be precisely careful about the whole business。
precisely 意为“精确地”，1960 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次测量那件薄薄的车票，副词置于动词之后。
precisely 意为“恰恰”，母亲 1962 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Precisely, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，司机恰恰在站台测量那件薄薄的车票；车站里人人都说那是头一回。（Precisely, …）
雨季到来之前，司机已经精确地测量那件薄薄的车票。（had precisely measured …）
那件薄薄的车票当时精确地相等。（precisely equal）
保管它的那位乘客在入冬前已经恰恰把它订过两回。（had precisely booked it）
叔叔精确地测量那件薄薄的车票，车站里没有一个人怀疑。（… precisely …）
在那个日子里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最精确地。（the most precisely of all of them）
answers: Precisely, in 1950 the driver measured the ticket at the platform.
Before the February rains the driver had precisely measured the ticket.
The passenger who kept it had precisely booked it twice before the winter came.
He measured the ticket precisely on the same day, and nobody in the station doubted it.
Of all who did it that day, he did it precisely with great care.

answers: Precisely, in 1950 the driver measured the ticket, and nobody forgot it.
Before the February rains the driver had precisely measured the ticket.
